name: Horse Race
text: Your [Horsetrack] is having a race. You can place a bet on a [Horse]

uniques: Set [Race Horses] to [1]
Gain [-50] [Gold] <hidden from users>
Triggers a [Horse Winner] event <hidden from users>
Set [Race Horses] to [2]
Gain [-50] [Gold] <hidden from users>
Triggers a [Horse Winner] event <hidden from users>
Set [Race Horses] to [3]
Gain [-50] [Gold] <hidden from users>
Triggers a [Horse Winner] event <hidden from users>
Set [Race Horses] to [4]
Gain [-50] [Gold] <hidden from users>
Triggers a [Horse Winner] event <hidden from users>
Gain [150] [Gold] <when number of [Race Horses] is equal to [1]>
Triggers the following global alert: [You won 100 Gold] <when number of [Race Horses] is equal to [1]>
Triggers the following global alert: [Unfortunately, Horse #4 won the race] <when number of [Race Horses] is different than [1]>
Gain [2000] [Gold] <when number of [Race Horses] is equal to [2]>
Triggers the following global alert: [You won 150 Gold] <when number of [Race Horses] is equal to [2]>
Triggers the following global alert: [Unfortunately, Horse #1 won the race] <when number of [Race Horses] is different than [2]>
Gain [300] [Gold] <when number of [Race Horses] is equal to [3]>
Triggers the following global alert: [You won 250 Gold] <when number of [Race Horses] is equal to [3]>
Triggers the following global alert: [Unfortunately, Horse #2 won the race] <when number of [Race Horses] is different than [3]>
Gain [400] [Gold] <when number of [Race Horses] is equal to [4]>
Triggers the following global alert: [You won 450 Gold] <when number of [Race Horses] is equal to [4]>
Triggers the following global alert: [Unfortunately, Horse #1 won the race] <when number of [Race Horses] is different than [4]>
